about.label: The Group
about.body: Grupo Saturno is a 100% Uruguayan company with over 26 years in the meat industry. We operate two own plants — Frigorífico Saturno in Empalme Olmos and Establecimiento Florida 365 — with active approvals to export to China (GACC), the United States (USDA), and the European Union. Every animal is individually identified from birth, under the world's most rigorous traceability system. From slaughter to shipment, without intermediaries.

chain.label: How we work
chain.body1: Our cattle graze on our own fields in Uruguay. Slaughter takes place at Establecimiento Florida 365. Processing, deboning and vacuum packing happen at our plant in Empalme Olmos. We coordinate distribution ourselves. The importer does not negotiate with a trader — they negotiate directly with the people who have known the animal since birth.
chain.body2: That is what vertical integration means in practice. Not as a marketing concept, but as something that changes the price, the control and the traceability of every kilo that leaves our plants.

items.title: From slaughter to shipment — inside the group
items.text: Establecimiento Florida 365 is our own slaughter plant. We produce, process, and export without handing control to third parties. One point of contact, real traceability at every stage.

items.title: Approved for the world's most demanding markets
items.text: We hold active export approvals for China (GACC), the United States (USDA), and the European Union. These are not targets — they are current certifications. If your market is one of them, we already meet its requirements.

items.title: The most rigorous traceability system on the planet
items.text: Uruguay is the only country in the world where 100% of the bovine herd is individually identified electronically from birth, by law. Every animal we process has a complete, verifiable history.

items.title: Grass-fed Uruguayan beef: the world's best, with scientific backing
items.text: A study published in Meat Sciences (Netherlands) concludes that Uruguay scientifically produces the best beef in the world. No growth hormones, on natural pastures year-round.

florida.heroDesc: Specialised plant for beef processing and export. Florida, Uruguay.
florida.presentationBody: Establecimiento Florida 365 is Grupo Saturno's own slaughter plant, acquired in 2025 and reopened in March 2026. With active approvals to export to China, the United States and the European Union, it is the link that completes the group's vertical integration: from field to container, without intermediaries.

markets.name: China
markets.text: Florida 365 holds an active GACC approval for the Chinese market. With the plant's reopening, the goal is to rebuild and strengthen ties with importers and trade delegations, and to develop new relationships in one of the most important markets for Uruguayan beef.

markets.name: United States
markets.text: The North American market demands the world's strictest sanitary protocols. Florida 365 holds an active USDA approval, enabling direct export of premium cuts to importers and distributors in the US.

markets.name: European Union
markets.cert: EU Approval — animal welfare and traceability
markets.text: Europe requires maximum traceability, animal welfare and the absence of growth hormones. Uruguay meets and exceeds all these requirements. Florida 365 is approved to export to all 27 member states.

florida.teaserBody: In March 2026 we celebrated a milestone in the group's history with the reopening of the plant, bringing together the President of the Republic, authorities, staff and strategic partners.
